title: From Pen-and-Paper to Machine-Checked Proofs: Lean for System Identification
abstract: arXiv:2611.18220v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mathematical proofs in scientific papers are often long and intricate, relying on chains of references to earlier results. This makes it difficult for readers and reviewers to verify each and every step. Interactive theorem proving offers a complement: the theorem and its proof are written as code, and every inference is checked by a small, trusted piece of software called the kernel. This paper serves as an introduction to the Lean 4 proof assistant for a system identification and control audience, assuming no prior exposure to formal methods. We first show how a Lean proof is read using two elementary examples: the first on identifiability, the second on set invariance. We then illustrate how Lean can be used to analyse results from the literature, taking as example a classic lemma on the inversion of the noise filter in prediction-error identification (Ljung, 1999, Lemma 3.1). translated_title: 从纸笔证明到机器验证证明：面向系统辨识的Lean
translated_abstract: 科学论文中的数学证明往往冗长复杂，并依赖于对先前结果的层层引用，这使得读者和审稿人难以逐步验证每一个细节。交互式定理证明提供了一种补充手段：定理及其证明以代码形式书写，每一步推理都由一个被称为“内核”的小型可信软件进行检验。本文面向系统辨识与控制领域的研究者，介绍Lean 4证明助手，且不要求读者具备形式化方法的先验知识。我们首先通过两个基础示例展示如何阅读Lean证明：第一个关于可辨识性，第二个关于集合不变性。随后，我们以预测误差辨识中噪声滤波器求逆的一个经典引理（Ljung, 1999, 引理3.1）为例，说明如何利用Lean分析文献中的已有结果。由于在Lean中每一步推理都必须有据可查，形式化的过程……
tldr: 本文向系统辨识与控制领域的研究者介绍Lean 4证明助手，通过可辨识性、集合不变性及预测误差辨识中经典引理的形式化示例，展示机器验证证明如何弥补传统纸笔证明难以逐步核验的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Lean 4 proof assistant to the system identification and control community, using elementary examples on identifiability, set invariance, and a classic prediction-error identification lemma to show how machine-checked proofs complement traditional pen-and-paper proofs by verifying every inference step.
